column2:
tackle(v.)處理、應付、擒抱
(無詞性變化)
tackle a problem 處理問題
tackle climate change 對付氣候變遷
The government must tackle the problem of rising housing prices.
(政府必須處理房價上漲的問題。)
The defender tackled the player and took the ball.
(後衛擒抱那名球員並搶下了球。)

tactic(n.)戰術、策略、tactics(n.)策略、手段(常用複數)
tactical(adj.)戰術上的
scare tactics 恐嚇手段
change tactics 改變策略
The coach changed tactics in the second half of the game.
(教練在下半場改變了戰術。)
Delaying the meeting was just a tactic to avoid the question.
(延後會議只是迴避問題的手段。)

tangle(n./v.)糾結、混亂、使糾纏
tangled(adj.)糾結的、複雜的
in a tangle 糾結在一起、一團亂
tangle with 與…爭吵
My headphone cords are always in a tangle.
(我的耳機線總是纏成一團。)
The kitten got tangled in a ball of yarn.
(小貓被一團毛線纏住了。)

tempt(v.)引誘、吸引、使想要
temptation(n.)誘惑
tempting(adj.)誘人的
be tempted to 很想…
tempting offer 誘人的提議
I was tempted to skip class and go to the beach.
(我很想翹課去海邊。)
The smell of fresh bread tempted me into the bakery.
(新鮮麵包的香味吸引我走進麵包店。)

temptation(n.)誘惑、誘惑物
tempt(v.)引誘
resist temptation 抵抗誘惑
give in to temptation 屈服於誘惑
It's hard to resist the temptation of fried chicken late at night.
(深夜很難抗拒炸雞的誘惑。)
Smartphones are a big temptation for students during class.
(智慧型手機對上課中的學生是很大的誘惑。)

terminal(n./adj.)航廈、終點站、末期的、終端的
terminate(v.)終止
airport terminal 機場航廈
terminal illness 絕症、末期疾病
Our flight leaves from Terminal 2.
(我們的班機從第二航廈出發。)
The patient was told that his cancer was terminal.
(那位病人被告知他的癌症已是末期。)

terrify(v.)使驚恐、使害怕
terrified(adj.)感到驚恐的
terrifying(adj.)令人驚恐的
be terrified of 非常害怕…
terrifying experience 可怕的經歷
Loud thunder terrifies my little dog.
(巨大的雷聲讓我的小狗嚇壞了。)
She is terrified of speaking in front of large crowds.
(她非常害怕在一大群人面前說話。)

testify(v.)作證、證明
testimony(n.)證詞、證明
testify against 作證指控
testify to 證明
The witness agreed to testify against the suspect in court.
(證人同意出庭作證指控嫌犯。)
Her success testifies to years of hard work.
(她的成功證明了多年的努力。)

texture(n./v.)質地、口感、使具有紋理
textured(adj.)有紋理的
smooth texture 滑順的質地
chewy texture 有嚼勁的口感
Taiwanese people love the chewy texture of tapioca pearls.
(台灣人喜愛粉圓有嚼勁的口感。)
This fabric has a soft and smooth texture.
(這塊布料的質地柔軟滑順。)

theft(n.)竊盜、偷竊
thief(n.)小偷
identity theft 身分盜用
car theft 汽車竊盜
Identity theft is becoming more common online.
(網路上的身分盜用越來越常見。)
He reported the theft of his bicycle to the police.
(他向警方報案說腳踏車被偷了。)

theology(n.)神學
theological(adj.)神學的
theologian(n.)神學家
study theology 研讀神學
Christian theology 基督教神學
He went to seminary to study theology.
(他去神學院研讀神學。)
The professor wrote several books on Christian theology.
(那位教授寫了好幾本關於基督教神學的書。)

theoretical(adj.)理論上的、理論的
theory(n.)理論
theoretically(adv.)理論上
theoretical knowledge 理論知識
theoretical physics 理論物理學
Students need both theoretical knowledge and practical skills.
(學生需要理論知識，也需要實作技能。)
Time travel is only a theoretical possibility.
(時光旅行只是一種理論上的可能。)

therapist(n.)治療師
therapy(n.)治療
physical therapist 物理治療師
speech therapist 語言治療師
The physical therapist helped him walk again after the accident.
(物理治療師幫助他在意外後重新走路。)
She wants to become a speech therapist to help children.
(她想成為語言治療師來幫助孩子。)

therapy(n.)治療、療法
therapeutic(adj.)治療的、有療效的
physical therapy 物理治療
music therapy 音樂治療
After the surgery, he needed months of physical therapy.
(手術後，他需要好幾個月的物理治療。)
Music therapy can help patients relax and feel better.
(音樂治療能幫助病人放鬆、感覺好一點。)

thereby(adv.)藉此、因此
(無詞性變化)
thereby reducing 藉此減少
thereby causing 因而造成
He trained hard every day, thereby improving his speed.
(他每天努力訓練，因而提升了速度。)
The city planted more trees, thereby reducing air pollution.
(市政府種植更多樹木，藉此減少空氣汙染。)

thesis(n.)論文、論點
(無詞性變化)
master's thesis 碩士論文
thesis statement 論點句、主旨句
She spent two years writing her master's thesis.
(她花了兩年寫碩士論文。)
A good essay begins with a clear thesis statement.
(一篇好文章以清楚的主旨句開頭。)

thigh(n.)大腿
(無詞性變化)
thigh muscle 大腿肌肉
chicken thigh 雞腿肉
He injured his thigh muscle during the race.
(他在比賽中拉傷了大腿肌肉。)
I ordered a grilled chicken thigh rice box for lunch.
(我午餐點了烤雞腿飯便當。)

threshold(n.)門檻、起點、界限
(無詞性變化)
on the threshold of 即將…、在…的開端
pain threshold 疼痛閾值
Young graduates are on the threshold of a new life.
(年輕的畢業生正站在新生活的起點。)
Your score must be above the threshold to pass.
(你的分數必須超過門檻才能及格。)

thrill(n./v.)興奮、激動、使興奮
thrilled(adj.)非常興奮的
thrilling(adj.)令人興奮的
the thrill of 的刺激
thrill seeker 尋求刺激的人
Riding a roller coaster gives me a great thrill.
(搭雲霄飛車讓我非常興奮刺激。)
We were thrilled to hear that we had won the contest.
(聽到我們贏得比賽，我們都興奮極了。)

thriller(n.)驚悚片、驚悚小說
thrill(n./v.)興奮、刺激
psychological thriller 心理驚悚片
crime thriller 犯罪驚悚片
I couldn't sleep after watching that psychological thriller.
(看完那部心理驚悚片後我睡不著。)
She enjoys reading crime thrillers on long train rides.
(她喜歡在長途火車旅程中讀犯罪驚悚小說。)

thrive(v.)繁榮、茁壯成長、興旺
thriving(adj.)蓬勃發展的
thrive on 從…中獲得成長或樂趣
thriving business 興旺的生意
These plants thrive in warm, humid weather.
(這些植物在溫暖潮濕的天氣中長得很茂盛。)
Some people thrive on pressure and challenges.
(有些人在壓力和挑戰下反而表現更好。)

throne(n.)王位、寶座
dethrone(v.)廢黜、取代
on the throne 在位
heir to the throne 王位繼承人
Queen Elizabeth II was on the throne for seventy years.
(伊莉莎白二世在位七十年。)
The prince is the heir to the throne.
(那位王子是王位繼承人。)

thrust(v./n.)猛推、刺、推力、要旨
(無詞性變化)
thrust into 推入、使陷入
main thrust 要點、主旨
She was suddenly thrust into the role of team leader.
(她突然被推上隊長的位置。)
The main thrust of his speech was about education reform.
(他演講的主旨是教育改革。)

tick(n./v.)滴答聲、打勾、壁蝨、(時鐘)滴答響
(無詞性變化)
tick the box 在方格內打勾
tick away 時間一分一秒流逝
Please tick the box if you agree to the terms.
(如果同意條款，請在方格內打勾。)
The minutes ticked away as we waited for the results.
(我們等待結果時，時間一分一秒過去。)

tile(n./v.)磁磚、瓦片、鋪磁磚
(無詞性變化)
floor tile 地磚
roof tile 屋瓦
The bathroom floor is covered with white tiles.
(浴室地板鋪著白色磁磚。)
Strong winds blew several tiles off the roof.
(強風把屋頂上幾片瓦片吹落。)

tin(n./v.)錫、罐頭、裝罐
tinned(adj.)罐裝的
tin can 錫罐、罐頭
cookie tin 餅乾鐵盒
Grandma keeps her buttons in an old cookie tin.
(奶奶把鈕扣放在一個舊餅乾鐵盒裡。)
The kids made a telephone with two tin cans and a string.
(孩子們用兩個罐頭和一條繩子做了電話。)

toll(n./v.)通行費、傷亡人數、損害、鳴(鐘)
(無詞性變化)
death toll 死亡人數
take a toll on 對…造成損害
The death toll from the earthquake continued to rise.
(地震的死亡人數持續攀升。)
Working late every night took a toll on his health.
(每晚熬夜工作損害了他的健康。)

torch(n./v.)火炬、手電筒、放火燒
(無詞性變化)
Olympic torch 奧運聖火
pass the torch 傳承
The Olympic torch was carried through many cities.
(奧運聖火被傳遞經過許多城市。)
The older generation must pass the torch to young leaders.
(老一輩必須將重任傳承給年輕的領導者。)

torment(n./v.)折磨、痛苦、使痛苦
tormentor(n.)折磨者
in torment 在痛苦中
torment by 被…折磨
He was in torment, unable to decide which school to choose.
(他無法決定要選哪間學校，內心十分煎熬。)
The prisoners were tormented by hunger and cold.
(囚犯們飽受飢寒折磨。)

tournament(n.)錦標賽、比賽
(無詞性變化)
tennis tournament 網球錦標賽
win the tournament 贏得錦標賽
Our school won the national basketball tournament this year.
(我們學校今年贏得全國籃球錦標賽。)
Teams from twelve countries took part in the tournament.
(來自十二個國家的隊伍參加了這場錦標賽。)

toxic(adj.)有毒的、有害的
toxin(n.)毒素
toxicity(n.)毒性
toxic waste 有毒廢棄物
toxic relationship 有害的關係
The factory was fined for dumping toxic waste into the river.
(那家工廠因將有毒廢棄物倒入河中而被罰款。)
It took her years to leave that toxic relationship.
(她花了好幾年才離開那段有害的關係。)

trait(n.)特質、特徵
(無詞性變化)
personality trait 人格特質
genetic trait 遺傳特徵
Honesty is one of his best personality traits.
(誠實是他最好的人格特質之一。)
Eye color is a genetic trait passed down from parents.
(眼睛顏色是從父母遺傳下來的特徵。)

traitor(n.)叛徒、賣國賊
treason(n.)叛國罪
betray(v.)背叛
traitor to one's country 賣國賊
be called a traitor 被稱為叛徒
He was called a traitor for selling secrets to the enemy.
(他因把機密賣給敵人而被稱為叛徒。)
In the story, the king's closest friend turns out to be a traitor.
(在故事裡，國王最親近的朋友原來是個叛徒。)

transaction(n.)交易、處理
transact(v.)處理、交易
online transaction 線上交易
business transaction 商業交易
All online transactions on this site are protected.
(此網站上的所有線上交易都受到保護。)
The bank charges a small fee for each transaction.
(銀行每筆交易都收取一小筆手續費。)

transformation(n.)轉變、變形、改造
transform(v.)轉變、改造
digital transformation 數位轉型
undergo a transformation 經歷轉變
The old factory underwent a transformation into an art center.
(那座舊工廠經過改造成了藝術中心。)
Many companies are going through digital transformation.
(許多公司正在進行數位轉型。)

transit(n./v.)運輸、過境、通過
transition(n.)轉變
public transit 大眾運輸
in transit 運送途中
Taipei has an excellent public transit system.
(台北有很好的大眾運輸系統。)
The package was damaged in transit.
(包裹在運送途中受損了。)

transition(n.)轉變、過渡
transitional(adj.)過渡的
transition from A to B 從A轉變到B
smooth transition 順利過渡
The transition from junior high to senior high can be challenging.
(從國中到高中的轉變可能充滿挑戰。)
The country is in transition to renewable energy.
(這個國家正處於轉型為再生能源的過渡期。)

transmission(n.)傳染、傳播、播送、變速器
transmit(v.)傳送、傳染
disease transmission 疾病傳染
data transmission 資料傳輸
Washing hands helps prevent the transmission of viruses.
(洗手有助於防止病毒傳播。)
5G networks allow much faster data transmission.
(5G網路讓資料傳輸快得多。)

transparent(adj.)透明的、易懂的、公開的
transparency(n.)透明、透明度
transparent glass 透明玻璃
transparent process 公開透明的程序
The box is made of transparent plastic.
(這個盒子是用透明塑膠做的。)
Citizens want the government to be more transparent.
(民眾希望政府更加公開透明。)

trauma(n.)創傷、損傷
traumatic(adj.)造成創傷的、痛苦的
emotional trauma 心理創傷
head trauma 頭部外傷
Many survivors suffered emotional trauma after the earthquake.
(許多倖存者在地震後遭受心理創傷。)
Losing his parents was a traumatic experience for him.
(失去父母對他來說是很痛苦的經歷。)

treaty(n.)條約、協定
(無詞性變化)
peace treaty 和平條約
sign a treaty 簽訂條約
The two countries signed a peace treaty after the war.
(兩國在戰後簽訂了和平條約。)
The treaty aims to reduce nuclear weapons.
(這項條約旨在減少核武。)

tribute(n.)致敬、讚揚、貢品
(無詞性變化)
pay tribute to 向…致敬
tribute concert 紀念音樂會
Fans paid tribute to the singer who passed away.
(歌迷們向那位過世的歌手致敬。)
The statue was built as a tribute to the brave firefighters.
(那座雕像是為了向英勇的消防員致敬而建。)

trigger(n./v.)扳機、起因、引發
(無詞性變化)
pull the trigger 扣扳機
trigger an allergy 引發過敏
Dust can trigger an allergic reaction in some people.
(灰塵可能引發某些人的過敏反應。)
Stress is often a trigger for headaches.
(壓力常是引發頭痛的原因。)

trim(v./n./adj.)修剪、削減、整潔的
(無詞性變化)
trim the hedge 修剪樹籬
trim the budget 削減預算
I need to trim my hair a little before the photo.
(拍照前我需要稍微修剪一下頭髮。)
The school had to trim its budget this year.
(學校今年必須削減預算。)

triple(adj./v./n.)三倍的、三重的、使成三倍、三倍
(無詞性變化)
triple the size 三倍大
triple jump 三級跳遠
The number of visitors has tripled since last year.
(訪客人數從去年以來增加了三倍。)
He won a gold medal in the triple jump.
(他在三級跳遠項目中贏得金牌。)

trivial(adj.)瑣碎的、不重要的
trivia(n.)瑣事、冷知識
trivial matter 瑣事
trivial mistake 小錯誤
Don't waste your time arguing over trivial matters.
(別浪費時間爭論瑣事。)
What seems trivial to you may be important to others.
(對你來說微不足道的事，對別人可能很重要。)

trophy(n.)獎盃、戰利品
(無詞性變化)
win a trophy 贏得獎盃
trophy cabinet 獎盃櫃
The captain proudly lifted the trophy above his head.
(隊長驕傲地把獎盃高舉過頭。)
The school's trophy cabinet is full of awards.
(學校的獎盃櫃裡擺滿了獎項。)

tuition(n.)學費、教學
(無詞性變化)
tuition fees 學費
private tuition 家教
Tuition fees at private universities are much higher.
(私立大學的學費高得多。)
She works part-time to help pay her tuition.
(她打工來幫忙支付學費。)

tumor(n.)腫瘤
(無詞性變化)
brain tumor 腦瘤
benign tumor 良性腫瘤
Doctors successfully removed the tumor from his lung.
(醫生成功切除了他肺部的腫瘤。)
Fortunately, the tumor turned out to be benign.
(幸好那個腫瘤是良性的。)

tuna(n.)鮪魚
(無詞性變化)
tuna sandwich 鮪魚三明治
canned tuna 鮪魚罐頭
I made a tuna sandwich for lunch.
(我做了一個鮪魚三明治當午餐。)
Pingtung is famous for its bluefin tuna.
(屏東以黑鮪魚聞名。)

ultimate(adj./n.)最終的、極致的、極品
ultimately(adv.)最後、終究
ultimate goal 最終目標
the ultimate in 極致的…
Her ultimate goal is to become an astronaut.
(她的最終目標是成為太空人。)
Ultimately, the decision is up to you.
(最終，決定權在你。)

uncover(v.)揭露、發現、揭開
(無詞性變化)
uncover the truth 揭露真相
uncover evidence 發現證據
The reporter worked for months to uncover the truth.
(那位記者花了好幾個月揭露真相。)
Archaeologists uncovered an ancient city under the sand.
(考古學家在沙下發現一座古城。)

undergo(v.)經歷、遭受、接受(手術等)
(無詞性變化)
undergo surgery 接受手術
undergo changes 經歷變化
My grandfather will undergo surgery next week.
(我爺爺下週要接受手術。)
Teenagers undergo many physical and emotional changes.
(青少年會經歷許多生理和情緒上的變化。)

undergraduate(n.)大學生、大學部學生
(無詞性變化)
undergraduate degree 學士學位
undergraduate student 大學部學生
She earned her undergraduate degree in economics.
(她取得了經濟學的學士學位。)
The course is open to all undergraduates.
(這門課開放給所有大學部學生修習。)

underline(v./n.)畫底線、強調、底線
(無詞性變化)
underline the key words 在關鍵字下畫線
underline the importance of 強調…的重要性
Underline the key words as you read the article.
(閱讀文章時在關鍵字下畫線。)
The accident underlines the importance of wearing seat belts.
(這起事故凸顯了繫安全帶的重要性。)

undermine(v.)破壞、削弱、損害
(無詞性變化)
undermine confidence 削弱信心
undermine efforts 破壞努力
Constant criticism can undermine a child's confidence.
(不斷的批評會削弱孩子的自信。)
Fake news undermines public trust in the media.
(假新聞損害了大眾對媒體的信任。)

undertake(v.)從事、承擔、著手進行
undertaking(n.)任務、事業
undertake a task 承擔任務
undertake research 從事研究
The team undertook the difficult task of cleaning the beach.
(團隊承擔了清理海灘的艱鉅任務。)
She plans to undertake research on ocean pollution.
(她計畫從事海洋汙染的研究。)

undo(v.)解開、取消、復原
(無詞性變化)
undo a button 解開鈕扣
undo the damage 彌補損害
Press Ctrl+Z to undo your last change.
(按Ctrl+Z可以復原上一個動作。)
It will take years to undo the damage to the environment.
(要彌補對環境的破壞需要好幾年。)

undoubtedly(adv.)無疑地、確實地
doubt(n./v.)懷疑
undoubted(adj.)無疑的
undoubtedly the best 無疑是最好的
undoubtedly true 確實如此
She is undoubtedly the best singer in our school.
(她無疑是我們學校最會唱歌的人。)
Technology will undoubtedly change the way we learn.
(科技無疑會改變我們學習的方式。)
